options.name: Animal Fury
options.benefit: Gain a bite attack while raging.

options.name: Clear Mind
options.benefit: Reroll one failed Will save while raging, once per rage.

options.name: Fearless Rage
options.benefit: Become immune to shaken and frightened conditions while raging.

options.name: Guarded Stance
options.benefit: Gain a scaling dodge bonus to Armor Class while raging.

options.name: Increased Damage Reduction
options.benefit: Increase your damage reduction by 1; this power can be selected up to three times.

options.name: Internal Fortitude
options.benefit: Become immune to sickened and nauseated conditions while raging.

options.name: Intimidating Glare
options.benefit: Make an adjacent foe shaken with an Intimidate check while raging.

options.name: Knockback
options.benefit: Attempt a bull rush in place of a melee attack while raging without provoking.

options.name: Low-Light Vision
options.benefit: Gain low-light vision while raging, or double its range if you already have it.

options.name: Mighty Swing
options.benefit: Automatically confirm one critical threat while raging, once per rage.

options.name: Moment of Clarity
options.benefit: Suspend rage benefits and penalties for one round, once per rage.

options.name: Night Vision
options.benefit: Gain darkvision 60 feet while raging.

options.name: No Escape
options.benefit: Use an immediate action to move up to double speed after a withdrawing foe, once per rage.

options.name: Powerful Blow
options.benefit: Add barbarian level to one damage roll while raging, once per rage.

options.name: Quick Reflexes
options.benefit: Make one additional attack of opportunity each round while raging.

options.name: Raging Climber
options.benefit: Add barbarian level as an enhancement bonus on Climb checks while raging.

options.name: Raging Leaper
options.benefit: Add barbarian level as an enhancement bonus on Acrobatics checks to jump while raging.

options.name: Raging Swimmer
options.benefit: Add barbarian level as an enhancement bonus on Swim checks while raging.

options.name: Renewed Vigor
options.benefit: Heal 1d8 plus Constitution modifier hit points once per day while raging, improving with level.

options.name: Rolling Dodge
options.benefit: Gain a scaling dodge bonus against ranged attacks while raging.

options.name: Roused Anger
options.benefit: Enter rage while fatigued, becoming exhausted afterward.

options.name: Scent
options.benefit: Gain the scent ability while raging.

options.name: Strength Surge
options.benefit: Add barbarian level to one Strength check or combat maneuver check while raging, once per rage.

options.name: Superstition
options.benefit: Gain a scaling morale bonus on saves against spells and supernatural or spell-like abilities while raging.

options.name: Surprise Accuracy
options.benefit: Gain a morale bonus on one attack roll while raging, once per rage.

options.name: Swift Foot
options.benefit: Increase your land speed by 5 feet while raging; this power can be selected up to three times.

options.name: Terrifying Howl
options.benefit: Panic nearby shaken enemies with a howl while raging.

options.name: Unexpected Strike
options.benefit: Make an attack of opportunity against a foe that moves into a threatened square, once per rage.

options.name: Beast Totem
options.benefit: Gain scaling natural armor while raging.

options.name: Beast Totem, Greater
options.benefit: Gain pounce while raging and improve the claws granted by Lesser Beast Totem.

options.name: Beast Totem, Lesser
options.benefit: Gain two primary claw attacks while raging.

options.name: Boasting Taunt
options.benefit: Use Intimidate while raging to taunt a creature into attacking you, with bonuses from drinks consumed.

options.name: Brawler
options.benefit: Gain Improved Unarmed Strike while raging, or improve existing unarmed damage.

options.name: Brawler, Greater
options.benefit: Gain Two-Weapon Fighting while raging when attacking with unarmed strikes.

options.name: Chaos Totem
options.benefit: Improve Escape Artist and gain a chance to ignore critical-hit and sneak-attack damage while raging.

options.name: Chaos Totem, Greater
options.benefit: Gain DR/lawful and treat your attacks as chaotic while raging.

options.name: Chaos Totem, Lesser
options.benefit: Gain defenses against lawful creatures and selected mental and transformational effects while raging.

options.name: Come and Get Me
options.benefit: Leave yourself open while raging so every enemy attack against you provokes a preemptive attack of opportunity.

options.name: Disruptive
options.benefit: Gain Disruptive as a bonus feat while raging.

options.name: Elemental Rage
options.benefit: Deal an extra 1d6 acid, cold, electricity, or fire damage with every melee attack while raging.

options.name: Elemental Rage, Greater
options.benefit: Deal additional chosen-energy damage on melee critical hits while raging.

options.name: Elemental Rage, Lesser
options.benefit: Once per rage, add 1d6 chosen-energy damage to melee attacks for 1 round.

options.name: Energy Absorption
options.benefit: Once per rage, absorb an attack of your resisted energy type and gain temporary hit points instead of taking damage.

options.name: Energy Eruption
options.benefit: Absorb an energy attack and unleash its damage later as a line or cone during the same rage.

options.name: Energy Resistance
options.benefit: Gain scaling resistance to one chosen energy type while raging; select this power once per different energy type.

options.name: Energy Resistance, Greater
options.benefit: Once per rage, halve damage from an attack covered by your Energy Resistance before applying resistance.

options.name: Ferocious Mount
options.benefit: Spend an extra rage round each round to grant rage benefits to your adjacent or ridden mount.

options.name: Ferocious Mount, Greater
options.benefit: Share constant rage powers with your raging mount.

options.name: Ferocious Trample
options.benefit: Grant your raging mount a damaging trample special attack.

options.name: Ferocious Trample, Greater
options.benefit: Let your mount trample creatures up to its size and overrun creatures that fail against the trample.

options.name: Fiend Totem
options.benefit: Grow damaging barbs that harm creatures striking you in melee while raging.

options.name: Fiend Totem, Greater
options.benefit: Radiate a damaging aura of menace against nearby good and neutral creatures while raging.

options.name: Fiend Totem, Lesser
options.benefit: Grow a gore attack while raging.

options.name: Flesh Wound
options.benefit: Once per rage, attempt a Fortitude save to halve an attack's damage and convert it to nonlethal damage.

options.name: Good for What Ails You
options.benefit: Drink while raging to retry saves against listed conditions or poison without suffering from a failed poison retry.

options.name: Ground Breaker
options.benefit: Once per rage, smash the floor to create difficult terrain and potentially knock nearby creatures prone.

options.name: Guarded Life
options.benefit: When reduced below 0 hit points while raging, convert lethal damage equal to your barbarian level to nonlethal damage and stabilize.

options.name: Hurling
options.benefit: Increase Lesser Hurling's range increment or maximum object size.

options.name: Hurling, Greater
options.benefit: Further increase Hurling's range increment or maximum object size.

options.name: Hurling, Lesser
options.benefit: Lift and throw appropriately sized objects as improvised ranged touch attacks while raging.

options.name: Hurling Charge
options.benefit: Draw and throw a hurled weapon during a charge before completing the charge with a melee attack.

options.name: Inspire Ferocity
options.benefit: Share Reckless Abandon's modifier with willing nearby allies for a Charisma-based duration.

options.name: Knockdown
options.benefit: Once per rage, replace a melee attack with a non-provoking trip that also deals Strength-modifier damage.

options.name: Liquid Courage
options.benefit: Each drink consumed during rage improves morale saves against mind-affecting effects, subject to a level-based cap.

options.name: Overbearing Advance
options.benefit: Deal Strength-bonus damage whenever you successfully overrun while raging.

options.name: Overbearing Onslaught
options.benefit: Overrun multiple targets in one round while raging with cumulative penalties after the first.

options.name: Reckless Abandon
options.benefit: Trade Armor Class for a scaling attack bonus while raging.

options.name: Roaring Drunk
options.benefit: Drinks consumed during rage improve Intimidate and fear-effect save DCs, subject to a level-based cap.

options.name: Smasher
options.benefit: Once per rage, ignore an object's hardness when attacking it or making a sunder maneuver.

options.name: Spellbreaker
options.benefit: Gain Spellbreaker as a bonus feat while raging.

options.name: Spirit Steed
options.benefit: Grant your raging mount DR/magic and magical natural attacks.

options.name: Spirit Totem
options.benefit: Gain a miss chance against nonadjacent attacks while raging.

options.name: Spirit Totem, Greater
options.benefit: Damage adjacent living enemies with negative energy and improve your spirit wisps' reach and damage.

options.name: Spirit Totem, Lesser
options.benefit: Surround yourself with spirit wisps that attack one adjacent living foe each round while raging.

options.name: Staggering Drunk
options.benefit: Drinks consumed during rage grant a dodge bonus against attacks of opportunity, subject to a level-based cap.

options.name: Witch Hunter
options.benefit: Gain a scaling damage bonus against creatures with spells or spell-like abilities while raging.
